notes.title: Hotfixes V1.01
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

A small hotfix to fix some bugs, as well as some balancing targeted towards Randomize Enemies mode.
Changelog:
- Minor update to currency sliding animation
- Buffed early game enemies if they appeared in the late game in Randomize Enemies mode
- Increased Channel Magic duration to 4
- Fixed cutscene visual bugs
- Fixed layering issues with some sprites
- Regen no longer triggers multiple times if player chooses to wait
- Fixed revive potion animation not playing
- Fixed missing collision boxes in Fala Town

Thanks for playing!
Toblue

notes.title: Update V1.0!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Update V1.0 is here!

Here's a full list of changes:
- [b]New Game mode: Randomize Runes[/b]
- [b]New Game mode: Randomize Enemies[/b]
- These modes will be unlocked on first game completion
- In Randomize Enemies mode, some enemies are balanced to prevent an overly punishing early game
- Improved HP bars' clarity and juiciness
- Added animations and SFX for Passives activating to improve clarity
- Completely reworked Gastro's sprites and animations
- Made damage text clearer
- Added a new soundtrack
- Added 3 new Steam Achievements

- Adjusted shop inventory
- Adjusted some enemies' stats
- Added interactable indicator to first crystal for added clarity
- Minor changes to UI elements
- Reduced delay on AOE attack transitioning
- Fixed inconsistency with fade mask colour
- Fixed title screen not displaying save files
- Fixed visual bug with HP bar colour change
- Fixed some animations not playing SFX

I hope you'll enjoy this update, and as always, thanks for playing!
Toblue

notes.title: Update v0.92
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

For this update I've:
- Added 5 potion animations
- Added animations for action priority
- Added animations for damage dealt and damage received mod
- Added animation for action knock-back

- Reworked hit particles
- Reworked spell cast particles
- Reworked several status icons

- Increased EP cost of Haste to 3
- Increased Channel Magic EP regain to 5
- Modified some enemies' decision making

- Fixed a bug with battle positions not resetting after restarting battle
- Fixed animations getting stuck after restarting battle
- Reduced occasional long delays when switching to next unit's turn

Thanks for playing!
Toblue

notes.title: Content Update v0.91
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Steam Achievements have been added to Talshard! There are a total of 8 achievements.
Also, a new NPC has been added for you to 'respec'. Moves learned by a character can now be returned as a rune into your inventory. Some minor bugs with the UI fixed.

Thanks for playing!
Toblue
